title: V2: containerd image-triggered daemon crash via malformed digest in subject-annotated descriptor (CVE-2026-95839)
description: A vulnerability in containerd's image manifest processing causes the containerd daemon to crash when handling images with a malformed digest in a subject-annotated descriptor. This can disrupt container operations, especially in Kubernetes environments where repeated image pull retries can repeatedly crash containerd on worker nodes. The issue is fixed in containerd versions 2.2.10, 2.3.7, and 2.4.2. Users should update to these versions or restrict image pulls to trusted registries as a workaround.
